summary: Re-tested CLMS fixes. All 3 fixes confirmed working. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (auth, reports CRUD/assign, maintenance-resolved flips computer to Operational, troubleshoot canned replies, role gating). Frontend: FIX#1 user sidebar nav-troubleshooting present and opens troubleshooting-page; FIX#2 shadcn Radix Select on /report works end-to-end (select-computer -> option-PC-012 with role='option' -> problem-description -> submit-report -> report-success -> go-my-reports -> my-reports-page shows new PC-012 Slow performance entry); FIX#3 admin nav-problem-reports navigates to /reports with reports-page testid. Regression: all 3 role dashboards (admin/tech/user) load with correct testids. Role gating redirects user from /reports and /technicians to /. Admin assign-tech flow: selected tech, clicked assign-tech-btn, status became Assigned. Troubleshooting chat 'my computer is slow' replies with text mentioning restart and report.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> as child of <option> inside the native Select used for assign-tech-select. Cosmetic dev-mode warning only, does not break functionality. Caused by UI.jsx Select wrapping option children through a formatter.

action_items: (Optional) Clean up hydration warning: ensure <option> children in UI.jsx Select receive raw text, not wrapped <span>. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 628 lines - approaching split threshold; consider modularising routes by resource.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True - browsers will reject credentialed requests from '*'; set explicit origins in .env for prod.
No rate limiting / brute force protection on /api/auth/login.
report_number uses count+1 which is race-prone under concurrent inserts; use a MongoDB counter collection.
assign_report does not clear status back to Pending on reassign; fine but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ report on PC-012 via user; marked Resolved via tech, flipping PC-012 back to Operational.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 fixes verified. Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 13 tests, ~3s). Known cosmetic hydration warning on /reports/:id ReportDetails page from native Select wrapping option children; non-blocking.
